observed_issue: The internal-note checkbox appeared after its label text in San, while Vue places the checkbox before the text. The control therefore occupied a different visual position.
root_cause: The migration reversed the two child nodes inside the reply footer label. Vue renders input-then-text, but the generated San template rendered text-then-input. Shared CSS could not compensate for the changed DOM order.
fix: Created a formal_30_v2 copy and restored the Vue child order by placing the checkbox input before the internal-note text. No state or interaction logic was changed.

manual_validation_progress.failed: The internal-note checkbox position did not match Vue.
passed: The internal-note checkbox appears before the label text, matching Vue.
Toggling the checkbox still changes whether a submitted message is an internal note.

manual_checks: Initial inbox title, open count, sorted ticket list, selected conversation, messages, SLA, properties, tags, and controls match Vue.
Search, status filtering, and tag filtering produce the same tickets and active tag styling as Vue.
Selecting a ticket resets reply and merge state and updates the conversation and properties panels.
Canned replies populate the draft without submitting or refreshing the page.
Sending public replies or internal notes appends the correct message, updates status when appropriate, and does not refresh the page.
Changing assignee and ticket status updates the ticket list, open count, selected properties, and filters.
Selecting a merge target and merging moves messages, removes the source ticket, and selects the target.
SLA minutes and safe, warning, or breached styling update consistently.
